# 1 Clement Chapter 32 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_032_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 32

**32:1** If you carefully consider each of these things, you will understand just how great the gifts are that he has given.

**32:2** For from Jacob come all the priests and Levites who serve before God's altar; from him, in terms of human descent, comes the Lord Jesus Christ; from him come the kings, rulers, and leaders of Judah; and his other tribes are held in no small honor, since God promised: "Your descendants shall be as the stars of heaven."

**32:3** All of these were glorified and exalted — not through themselves, not through their own deeds or righteous accomplishments, but through his will.

**32:4** And in the same way, we who have been called by his will in Christ Jesus are not justified by ourselves — not by our wisdom, not by our insight, not by our devotion, not by anything we have done in purity of heart — but through faith. Through faith the Almighty God has justified all who have existed from the beginning of time. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.

---

*PNEUMA renders the climactic justification-by-faith statement (v. 4) with maximum rhetorical force, making the repeated negations emphatic to match Clement's building cadence.*
